**Line 106 in src/index.js**: `_schema.handler(type, name, handler)`

This line applies globally registered handlers to the schema during middleware execution. These handlers (parsers, formatters, validators) process user-controlled query parameters, creating a potential attack vector if malicious handlers can be registered.
